body: Founder hit real Permission denied running emily redgarden bots 19 -- inherited XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/0 pointed systemctl --user at root's session bus instead of the founder's own uid-1000 session. redgardenSystemctlEnv() now always overrides to /run/user/<actual-uid> instead of only filling it in when unset. Also fixed a correctness bug this exposed: a failed daemon-reload/restart after a successful unit-file write left the file out of sync with the still-running pool -- both steps now roll the file back on failure. Verified against the founder's exact broken env (reproduced XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/0): bots 19 now writes/reloads/restarts correctly, live pool confirmed at 19. Commit 2837e49.
title: emily redgarden: fix XDG_RUNTIME_DIR permission denied + add rollback on partial failure
